title: [3.0-beta11] Seemingly random BS alerts
symptom: User receives seemingly random BS measurement alerts in AAPS, both during day and night, with configuration: Dana-i pump, Dexcom G6 CGM connected to BYODA app, AAPS 3.0-beta11 on Galaxy S10e Android 11. Alerts occur at random times despite full permissions and deactivated energy optimization.
cause: The alert stems from a 'Check BG' alert from the Dana-i pump, which is intended to remind manual pump users to check BG after a bolus. The alerts were suspected to be triggered by SMBs.
fix: Set alert melody to '0' in the doctors menu of the Dana-i pump to disable these alerts.
evidence_quote: By setting alert melody to "0" in the doctors menu, these alerts are disabled.
